name: Sora Suegami
description: Sora Suegami is a cryptography researcher and engineer focused on cryptographic theory and blockchain security since 2018. He co-founded ZK Email, which uses zero-knowledge proofs to verify email contents privately, and led the development of on-chain protocols including email-based account recovery. In 2025, he began research at the Ethereum Foundation aimed at making indistinguishability obfuscation practical. He presented Diamond iO at the Simons Institute’s Obfuscation Workshop.
